description: This file contains utility classes and functions for testing the reporting component in Chromium, including mock implementations of uploaders, delegates, and context setup for testing reporting features.

classes.name: PendingUploadImpl
classes.description: Mock implementation of a pending upload used in testing reporting uploads.

methods.name: ErasePendingUpload
methods.description: Removes a specific pending upload from the uploads vector.

methods.name: TestReportingRandIntCallback
methods.description: Returns a callback that generates pseudo-random integers within a range for testing.

methods.name: TestReportingUploader::StartUpload
methods.description: Simulates starting an upload in the test uploader, storing the upload in a list.

methods.name: TestReportingDelegate::CanSendReports
methods.description: Simulates permission checks for sending reports, with options to pause or disallow.

methods.name: TestReportingContext::CreateContext
methods.description: Initializes a test reporting context with specified policy and time.
